stanza: There were too many spaces in the line
They all agreed with hand on heart
Clings To her wet body in the rain
Knuckles white upon the slippery reins
She bravely waves the boys goodbye again
Ooo, Maggie what have you done?

handkerchief.linePrev: Leaving the note that she hoped would say more
handkerchief.line: She goes downstairs to the kitchen clutching her handkerchief
stanza: Wednesday morning at 5 o'clock as the day begins
Leaving the note that she hoped would say more
She goes downstairs to the kitchen clutching her handkerchief
